name: artifact-sftp
description: MCP-only AI-agent publishing and local read-back for HTML artifacts on your SFTP web host, with Sarabun as the Thai font default.

interface.shortDescription: MCP-only publish, read, and groom HTML artifacts
interface.longDescription: Routes AI agents through a local stdio MCP server to publish and locally read back HTML artifacts on an SFTP web host. Publishing is private by default, archives source bytes locally, avoids private viewer fetches, and applies Sarabun as the default Thai font.
defaultPrompt: Publish this report as an artifact
Update my published artifact in place
Read the artifact I just published
Audit and groom all artifacts in this project
